text:
Eli (Docs): quick one — I opened a compact Optimize toolkit PR that is a one-page checklist + tiny SDK snippets for batching, KV prefetch, and quant-profile migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1163 (draft)
Harper R.: thanks! can we keep it extremely short — teams want a single page to copy from. include a one-line migration map and one-line release-note blurb.
Eli (Docs): yes. plan: 1) one-line mapping YAML, 2) Node + Python minimal snippets, 3) a single decision line for q4_0 vs q8_0, 4) a short "avoid aggressive batching" checklist.
Maya (Runtime): please ensure all snippets use runtime default timeoutMs=10 and show the newer package names (@redwood/inference-js, redwood.inference). also mention kv_prefetch memory tradeoff.
Eli (Docs): done. pasted the final micro-snippets for quick sanity-check: 
```
// Node minimal per-route (copy-paste)
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});
await client.createRoute('mini', {
  model: 'open-llama-13b-v2',
  batching: {maxTokensPerBatch: 600, maxBatchSize: 4, timeoutMs: 10},
  kv_prefetch: {enabled: true, ttlSeconds: 180}
});
```
```
# Python minimal per-route (copy-paste)
from redwood.inference import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
client.create_route('mini', config={
  'model': 'open-llama-13b-v2',
  'batching': {'max_tokens_per_batch': 600, 'max_batch_size': 4, 'timeout_ms': 10},
  'kv_prefetch': {'enabled': True, 'ttl_seconds': 180}
})
```
Eli (Docs): and the one-line YAML migration map: 
```
# quant-mapping.yml
old_compat_small: q4_0  # validate on your eval set; switch to q8_0 if quality drops
old_compat_large: q8_0  # prefer for instruction-heavy flows
```
Harper R.: can we surface one concrete bench number? teams like a small data point.
bench-bot: small synthetic run (batch=4): q4_0 median token-latency 36ms, q8_0 median 54ms; token-cost delta ~ -30% for q4_0. gist: https://bench.redwood/q4q8-mini
Eli (Docs): added that one-liner under "Tradeoff example".
Maya (Runtime): add a single sentence: "Avoid batching windows > timeout that push average latency above your SLO; for sub-100ms SLOs prefer smaller maxBatchSize or disable batching." Also add: "KV prefetch reduces repeated-prefix compute but increases host memory usage proportional to stored KV size."
Eli (Docs): both added. ci-bot: running linkcheck and examples lint now.
ci-bot: ci/docs-linkcheck flagged an old model alias and a stale import in examples/node; details: open-llama-13b -> open-llama-13b-v2; replace @redwood/sdk.
Eli (Docs): fixed imports and model alias, repushed. small text tweak to avoid future-tense per style guidance.
Harper R.: final ask: add a one-line release note under Unreleased: "Optimize toolkit: add compact heuristics quickref for batching, kv prefetch, and quant-profile migration" and an anchor id #optkit-mini to link from the release notes.
Eli (Docs): release-note blurb and anchor added. requesting final review from Maya.
Maya (Runtime): LGTM. small suggestion: include a terse JSON example of a route config for teams that programmatically apply configs (many infra teams use this).
Eli (Docs): added a single-line JSON example: `{"model":"open-llama-13b-v2","batching":{"maxTokensPerBatch":600,"maxBatchSize":4,"timeoutMs":10},"kv_prefetch":{"enabled":true,"ttlSeconds":180}}` inside the guide. merging after CI passes. thanks all :sparkles:
